exitCriteria.title: The forest definition is published in the glossary in English and French
exitCriteria.reason: FOREST_DEFINITION carries bilingual text and per-locale glossary anchors, the glossary publishes a Forest and a Forêt entry, and a test pins the published minimum area, crown closure and mature height to the constant so the prose cannot drift from the value that drives computation.

exitCriteria.title: The confidence rule set produces a generated explanation for every rule, in both languages, verified by a unit test
exitCriteria.reason: assignConfidence returns a localized reason for all eight branches across the four declared rule identifiers; the unit test proves each identifier is reachable, that no undeclared identifier is produced, that English and French are both present and genuinely differ, and that unknown is never converted into a confident level.

exitCriteria.title: The source ledger rejects a test dataset that is missing a licence identifier
exitCriteria.reason: validateExampleSourceLedgerEntry throws on a missing licence identifier, and the unit test asserts that rejection alongside bilingual explanation, checksum and HTTPS rejections.

exitCriteria.title: Legal sign-off is recorded in the decision log
exitCriteria.reason: The accountable owner recorded full bilingual legal sign-off for the current disclaimers, terms, privacy notice, source-licensing and attribution rules, account and alert controls, and correction and dispute routes. The bilingual public decision log exposes the scope and its limits without representing it as an independent counsel opinion.

exitCriteria.title: The engagement contact route answers a test message within 5 business days
exitCriteria.exclusionScope: The owner removed Indigenous engagement, the engagement contact route, its five-business-day test, and the Mistik request from the approved product scope. This exclusion does not claim the route was tested and does not permit a product surface to imply that engagement occurred.
exitCriteria.reason: The owner explicitly decided not to operate an Indigenous engagement program. No route was opened, no test message was sent or answered, and no engagement occurred. Engagement-dependent production claims remain unavailable rather than fabricating a contact route or response.

exitCriteria.title: The product name resolves from one token, proven by a test
exitCriteria.reason: The brand token is the single source of the product name, a checker enforces that no surface hard-codes it, and a unit test proves that changing the token changes every surface.

exitCriteria.title: Both names are registered in both languages
exitCriteria.reason: The accountable owner attested that bilingual name-registration evidence is complete and retained Witness Tree / Arbre témoin as the product names. The repository records that attestation without exposing private registrar credentials or payment data.

exitCriteria.title: no persistent identifier contains the product name
exitCriteria.reason: A gate reads the product name from the brand token and rejects any route segment or path literal that carries it in any joined, accent-stripped spelling. Its tests prove it rejects a violating route and a violating path, and that renaming the brand token changes what it rejects.

countingBoundary: An unweighted count of the eight literal Phase 0 exit criteria published in section 16 of the controlling plan. Seven criteria pass and one is an explicit owner-approved scope exclusion, so this is not a cumulative maturity percentage and not a measure of production readiness. The exclusion is reported separately and is never represented as a completed engagement test.
